policy.purpose: Persist official first-party vacancy details for roles explicitly kept by the user when the broad ATS inventory/search does not enumerate them.
policy.verification: A fallback record may be reconciled only if its canonical URL is on the mapped official ATS host/site, its source ID matches the URL/detail response, its geography is in scope, and the official Workday CXS detail endpoint is live.
policy.lifecycle: These records are discovery/reconciliation hints only; user_job_decisions.json remains authoritative for TO_REVIEW/INTERESTED/APPLIED/NOT_INTERESTED.
